parsedVerdict.reasoning:
VisitNotesService is in the business layer, which has the domain kind. Its notesFor method takes an optional `request?: Request` parameter typed with Express's HTTP request type. That is a web/transport type in a domain method signature. The rubric counts this as a violation even when the parameter is optional and never used, so the flag is confirmed.

The two domain-does-io flags (prisma.visitNote.create and findMany) are dismissed. Those calls go through the injected PrismaService, a class the project declares in the persistence layer, and the layer model lets business depend on persistence. The rubric says a call to a class of a layer this layer may depend on is not misplaced I/O, whatever that layer does behind it. The service does not create the client itself, import it from a package or get it from a global accessor. The PrismaService constructor parameter is allowed dependency wiring.
